items.difficulty_reason: The proposition states that the three equivariant bordism groups defined earlier fit into a G-equivariant version of the Stolz positive scalar curvature exact sequence, with the three maps given by taking the boundary, forgetting the metric, and viewing a closed manifold as a manifold with empty boundary (statement lines 367-376). The proof is a complete case-by-case verification: it first checks that each composite of two consecutive maps vanishes, then constructs an explicit preimage for every class that lies in a kernel, the last case by gluing two bordisms along their common boundary and passing to the cylinder of the resulting closed manifold (proof lines 377-431). The step that carries the content is the last inclusion, since it requires building a bordism in the relative group out of two given ones; the other five verifications are direct consequences of the definitions. The argument is self-contained, the citation being only a pointer to the non-equivariant statement. H2.
